documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting Held On October 30, 2026
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM
Board Meeting Intimation for Meeting To Be Held On October 30, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Vadilal Industries reported FY19 consolidated revenue growth of 3% on a reported basis and 13% on an adjusted like-to-like basis. International operations delivered 54% revenue growth in FY19 to cross $20 million, driving gross margin expansion of over 600 basis points. Management started FY20 with double-digit domestic summer growth and expects double-digit growth overall alongside margin expansion. To offset rising milk prices, the company plans to evaluate price increases in the second half of the year while continuing regular annual capex of Rs. 30-35 crore.

guidance.claim: Management expects to deliver double-digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.
guidance.quote: We also expect to deliver double digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.

guidance.claim: Management expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore on regular capital expenditure during the year.
guidance.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

guidance.claim: Vadilal expects another good year in FY20 as it leverages its brand for growth.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we see another good year in FY20 as we leverage the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.

guidance.claim: Lower input costs and continued focus on developing domestic business are expected to drive growth.
guidance.quote: Continued focus on developing domestic business and lower input costs expected to drive growth

guidance.claim: Management maintains a positive business outlook driven by a better environment for consumption, demand shift to the organized sector, and continued traction in international business.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we maintain our positive business outlook – better environment for consumption, demand shift to the organized sector and continued traction in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic ice cream consumption was impacted in core markets in Q4 due to severe weather extending winter till late March.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

demand_outlook.claim: International revenues grew 54% in FY19 to exceed $20 million due to strong demand among the Indian diaspora.
demand_outlook.quote: International revenues continued to deliver encouraging expansion to cross the $ 20 million milestone, on the back of 54% revenue growth during FY19.

demand_outlook.claim: FY20 started with double-digit growth in the summer season and 25% expansion in international business.
demand_outlook.quote: We have started FY20 with double digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business revenue growth in Q3 FY19 was driven by higher volumes.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business was driven by higher volumes

demand_outlook.claim: International business revenues grew by 71% year-on-year in Q3 FY19.
demand_outlook.quote: International business revenues grew by 71% yoy

demand_outlook.claim: Latent demand for quality Indian products is driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales.
demand_outlook.quote: Latent demand for quality Indian products driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business growth is reverting to historical trends after temporary impacts from operating environment changes and consumption spending.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends

demand_outlook.claim: Ice cream volumes expanded by 6.9% in Q2, driven by 6% domestic volume growth and 37% expansion in international business.
demand_outlook.quote: During Q2, we have continued our strong business momentum to expand ice cream volumes by 6.9%, driven by 6% domestic volume growth and 37% expansion in the international business.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects to incur Rs. 30-35 crore in regular capital expenditure during the year.
capex_expansion.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

capex_expansion.claim: No major capital expenditure is anticipated for capacity enhancement.
capex_expansion.quote: No major capital expenditure anticipated on capacity enhancement

capex_expansion.claim: Estimated capex for FY19 is approximately Rs. 35 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points in FY19 due to volume growth, benign input costs, and higher international realizations.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year on the back of volume growth, benign raw material prices and larger contribution from international operations, where realizations are significantly higher.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points in FY19 due to tight control on operating expenses.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points and profit after tax more than doubled.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of human resources increased significantly due to expansion in US operations.
margins_costs.quote: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, with a large contribution from U.S. operations that now have a base of over 50 employees.

margins_costs.claim: The company has visibility of stable raw material costs covered till Q2.
margins_costs.quote: Based on our raw material purchase and inventory position, we have visibility of stable costs covered till Q2.

margins_costs.claim: The company will look to increase product prices in the second half of the year due to higher milk prices.
margins_costs.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded to 50% in Q3 FY19 from 40% in Q3 FY18.
margins_costs.quote: gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: Vadilal has closed key supply arrangements for the summer season, providing visibility on input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Having already closed key supply arrangements for the upcoming summer season, we have clear visibility of input costs and expect strong contribution from sales.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin expanded by over ~1,000 bps during Q2 FY19.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have improved significantly during the quarter – gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin by over ~1,000 bps.

margins_costs.claim: Subdued raw material prices for the upcoming season are expected to benefit margins.
margins_costs.quote: We have been engaging with raw material suppliers for the next season and prices continue to be subdued, which should benefit margins.

orders_capacity.claim: Total production capacity expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over recent years.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years

orders_capacity.claim: The Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh facility has an ice cream production capacity of 150,000 liters per day.
orders_capacity.quote: Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh 150,000 liters per day Ice cream ISO-22000:2005

orders_capacity.claim: The Pundhra, Gujarat facility has an ice cream production capacity of 230,000 liters per day.
orders_capacity.quote: Pundhra, Gujarat 230,000 liters per day Ice cream ISO-22000:2005 and BRC : Issue 6

orders_capacity.claim: Vadilal is present in 55,000 retail outlets across 26 states in India.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, we are present in 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states across the country.

orders_capacity.claim: The Dharampur plant in Gujarat has a processed foods production capacity of 33,000 kgs per day.
orders_capacity.quote: Dharampur, Gujarat 33,000 kgs per day Processed foods ISO-22000:2005 and BRC : Issue 6

capital_allocation.claim: The company reconstituted outstanding debt to increase long-tenure loans and reduce borrowing costs.
capital_allocation.quote: Reconstituted outstanding debt to increase long tenure loans and reduced cost of debt

capital_allocation.claim: Management plans to leverage operational surplus to rationalize debt and improve working capital management.
capital_allocation.quote: Leveraging surplus generated by operations to rationalize/ restructure debt and improve working capital management

risks_headwinds.claim: Extended winter conditions until late March impacted Q4 domestic ice cream consumption in core markets.
risks_headwinds.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

risks_headwinds.claim: Higher milk prices represent an input cost risk leading the company to evaluate second-half price hikes.
risks_headwinds.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Q3 is Vadilal's seasonally weakest quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: Another key achievement is the significantly lower loss in Q3, which is our seasonally weakest quarter – reflective of the increasing diversification in our business profile.

risks_headwinds.claim: Domestic business growth was temporarily impacted by recent changes in the operating environment and consumption spending.
risks_headwinds.quote: Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore on regular capital expenditure during the year.
management_commitments.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

management_commitments.claim: Management will look to increase product prices in the second half of the year.
management_commitments.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

management_commitments.claim: Vadilal sees another good year in FY20 as it leverages its brand for growth.
management_commitments.quote: Going forward, we see another good year in FY20 as we leverage the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.

management_commitments.claim: Estimated capex for FY19 is around Rs. 35 crore.
management_commitments.quote: Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore
